name: A lead east from Darnassus

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Velinde’s final entry says she means to seek passage from a port in the Barrens and follow a lead concerning Arugal. Thyn’tel turns that intention into the seeker’s next task: speak to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet. The quest order traces an investigation; it does not prove every step of Velinde’s own travel or that she ever reached the wizard. One last plan survives in her writing. Beyond it, the trail must be tested against the accounts of people who worked the docks.
